liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Reviewer ranks this Jack Straw among the best versions ever played [7]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer calls this Other One one of the best ever versions of the song [7]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Reviewer calls this Sugar Magnolia and the Other One ridiculously hot [10]
- Reviewer describes Garcia's solo building through three verse passes, with arpeggios, tension and a big climax, in a song that isn't named [8]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-11-05.aud.zimmerman.minches.81180.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 178 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1977-11-05.152194.aud.warburton.smith.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 174 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd77-11-05.sbd.clugston.6934.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 165 min; rated 4.44/5 by 25 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says Jerry's solos are lyrical, with a clear beginning, middle and end, making them compelling to sing along with; Reviewer says sound quality hardly matters for this recording; Reviewer finds this soundboard has far too much bass [7][8][15][18]
- **gd1977-11-05.152193.aud.warburton.smith.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 21 songs; 174 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]

## Around the show

- Band repeatedly urged the crowd to take a step back during the night; energy felt high from lights-down [9]
- Reviewer thinks this show topped the band's 1976 Rochester War Memorial performance and calls it among the great shows of 1977 [9]
- Reviewer says Fall 1977 had rougher, harder-rocking songbook treatment than other years, when the band was more mellow [10]
- Reviewer says the November 1977 shows are all monsters [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-11-05.aud.zimmerman.minches.81180.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Alan Zimmerman; transferred by David Minches; source: Master Audience Cassette; Sony Stereo Mic> Sony TC-158 (Maxell UD XLII-90s) [1]. Also: Patch for It Must Have Been The Roses came from Jerry Moore's master; Sony ECM-33P mics, Sony 158 master, Tascam cassette deck, DAT by Mark Cohen [1]
- **gd1977-11-05.152194.aud.warburton.smith.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jimmy Warburton; transferred by Matt Smith and Scott Clugston; source: Jimmy Warburton's Master Audience Cassettes; most likely AKG d1000e mics > unknown deck (dolby on); master cassettes (Nakamichi 550, dolby off) > 1st… [2]. Also: An unknown audience source supplies crowd sound, the opening of Mama Tried, and patches in Samson & Delilah and the pre-Other One jam [2]
- **gd77-11-05.sbd.clugston.6934.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [4]. Also: Reviewer identifies the show as Dick's Picks volume 34 [16]
- **gd1977-11-05.152193.aud.warburton.smith.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Jimmy Warburton; transferred by Matt Smith, Scott Clugston; source: Jimmy Warburton's Master Audience Cassettes; most likely AKG d1000e mics > unknown deck (dolby on); master cassettes (Nakamichi 550, dolby off) > 1st… [3]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Community War Memorial - November 5, 1977](https://www.dead.net/show/november-5-1977) [20]
